# Rendered at MAP=415W FTP=290W

========================================================================
seedId: 20-min-warm-up
name:   20 Min Warm Up
folder: Coach: Race
basis:  FTP @ 290w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Pre-race warm-up. Progressive build to threshold, then short activations to prime the legs.

Standardised pre-race warm-up: a graded build through endurance to a minute at threshold, then three 10-second activations and a final 5-second effort with full recoveries between.

- 5m 145w-175w

- 3m 175w-205w

- 1m 220w-245w

- 1m 275w-305w

- Recovery 2m 130w-160w

- Activation 10s 435w-580w

- Recovery 1m 130w-160w

- Activation 10s 435w-580w

- Recovery 2m 130w-160w

- Activation 10s 435w-580w

- Recovery 2m 130w-160w

- Activation 5s 435w-580w

- Cooldown 10m 115w-145w

========================================================================
seedId: 2s-and-3s
name:   2's and 3's
folder: Coach: VO2 Max
basis:  FTP @ 290w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Alternating 2- and 3-min efforts at 120–140% FTP with full recoveries. Repeatability above threshold.

Alternating 2- and 3-minute efforts well above threshold with long, genuine recoveries. The last effort steps up to 130–140% — the session is about holding quality to the end, not accumulating time. If the final rep can't match the first, stop rather than dilute it.

- Warm up 15m 115w-145w

- Effort 2m 350w-375w

- Recovery 5m 145w-175w

- Effort 3m 350w-375w

- Recovery 5m 145w-175w

- Effort 2m 365w-390w

- Recovery 5m 145w-175w

- Effort 3m 350w-375w

- Recovery 5m 145w-175w

- Effort 2m 375w-405w

- Cooldown 10m Z1

folder: Coach: Tests
basis:  FTP @ 290w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Re-establish FTP when threshold targets need recalibrating. FTP = 95% of best 20-min power.

20-minute FTP estimation test. Use FTP = 95% of best 20-min average. Pace target = bury yourself starting at minute 17. Standardise warm-up so retests are comparable.

- Warm-up 15m 160w-190w

- 1m 290w

- 1m 175w

- 1m 320w

- 1m 175w

- 1m 350w

- 5m 175w

- Threshold test 20m 275w-305w

- Cooldown 10m 145w

========================================================================
seedId: in-the-red-pursuit-intervals-2km
name:   In the red pursuit intervals (2km)
folder: Coach: Race
basis:  FTP @ 290w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Race-specific 2 km pursuit simulation — sprint start, then decaying power through anaerobic and VO2 zones.

Pursuit-style effort with a progressive ramp-up, two activation sprints, then 5 × pursuit intervals stepping down from peak sprint power through anaerobic and VO2max zones. Each rep rehearses the shape of the event: a standing-start surge, then settling into a decaying but sustainable pace. Keep cadence above 100 rpm through the anaerobic and VO2 steps.

- Warm Up 5m 175w

- Ramp 1 1m 205w

- Ramp 2 1m 225w

- Ramp 3 1m 245w

- Ramp 4 1m 265w

- Ramp 5 1m 285w

- Ramp 6 1m 305w

- Recovery 2m 160w

Activation 2x
- Activation Sprint 10s 725w
- Easy 1m 160w

- Recovery 3m 160w

Main Set 4x
- Sprint 20s 725w
- Anaerobic 40s 130% 100-130rpm
- VO2 1m30s 110% 100-130rpm
- Recovery 8m 160w

- Cool Down 5m 115w

========================================================================
seedId: map-ramp-test
name:   MAP ramp test
folder: Coach: Tests
basis:  MAP @ 415w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Re-establish MAP every 6–8 weeks or at a mesocycle start. Fixed rungs (140 W, +25 W/min) — only the ladder's length follows MAP, so retests stay comparable.

Ramp test to exhaustion. MAP = highest 60-second power. Watts are guidance — the test is open-ended, ride to failure. Standardise the warm-up across retests. Test every 6–8 weeks or at mesocycle starts.

Stepped 1-min protocol (+25 W/min after a graded warm-up) so each target renders on the head unit — a single continuous ramp collapses to one average wattage and can't be executed. Fixed rungs in absolute watts, never re-anchored: MAP gains show up as reaching higher steps and lasting longer, not as rescaled targets. Only the top of the ladder is generated from current MAP (the first rung above it plus two more), so the athlete cannot run out of steps; the rungs themselves are the same at any MAP.

- Warm-up (graded, standardised) 3m 150w

- 3m 180w

- 3m 210w

- 3m 240w

- Ramp to failure 1m 140w

- 1m 165w

- 1m 190w

- 1m 215w

- 1m 240w

- 1m 265w

- 1m 290w

- 1m 315w

- 1m 340w

- 1m 365w

- 1m 390w

- 1m 415w

- 1m 440w

- 1m 465w

- 1m 490w

- Cooldown 10m 160w

========================================================================
seedId: openers
name:   Openers
folder: Coach: Race
basis:  FTP @ 290w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Day before a race or hard test. Opens the legs through to a sprint without accruing fatigue.

Pre-race opener. Long steady base, one threshold block, then two short supra-threshold efforts and a single sprint to sharpen without cost. The intent is neuromuscular readiness, not stimulus — if it leaves you tired, it was ridden too hard.

- Warm up 20m 155w-190w

- Tempo 10m 210w-255w

- 10m 170w-205w

- Threshold 5m 260w-320w

- 10m 155w-190w

- Opener 1m 330w-400w

- 3m 155w-190w

- Opener 1m 330w-400w

- 3m 155w-190w

- Sprint 0m10s 655w-800w

- Cooldown 10m Z1

========================================================================
seedId: vo2-4x4-surges
name:   VO2 4×4 with surges
folder: Coach: VO2 Max
basis:  MAP @ 415w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Long-rep VO2 variant — same mean power as 4×4, with three 30 s surges per rep to lift VO2.

Same mean power as `vo2-4x4`, redistributed: three 30 s surges to ~MAP inside each 4-min rep, with settles between. In trained cyclists this raised time above 90% VO₂max at matched mean power (Bossi et al., 2020; acute lab data, one study). The surges aren't sprints — ride them at MAP, not above. Heart rate won't show the difference; judge it on power.

- Warm-up 15m 210w-250w

4x
- Surge 30s 395w-415w
- Settle 1m 290w-310w
- Surge 30s 395w-415w
- Settle 1m 290w-310w
- Surge 30s 395w-415w
- Settle 30s 290w-310w
- Off 4m 210w

- Cooldown 10m 185w

<!-- template: vo2-4x4-surges -->

========================================================================
seedId: vo2-4x4
name:   VO2 4×4
folder: Coach: VO2 Max
basis:  MAP @ 415w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Long-rep VO2 session — the entry point to the main VO2 block, and VO2 maintenance.

Classic VO₂max session: 4 min hard with equal recovery. Self-paced inside the band: the highest power you can repeat, final rep ≥ first rep. 78–85% MAP is a starting anchor for a rider whose FTP:MAP is low; recalibrate it to 90–95% of a 5-min test once one exists. (Seiler et al., 2013; Stern, CycleCoach 2025.)

- Warm-up 15m 210w-250w

4x
- On 4m 325w-355w
- Off 4m 210w

- Cooldown 10m 185w

<!-- template: vo2-4x4 -->

========================================================================
seedId: vo2-preloaded-shorts
name:   VO2 preloaded shorts
folder: Coach: VO2 Max
basis:  MAP @ 415w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Short-intermittent VO2 session — the second half of the main VO2 block, after the long-rep weeks.

Each series opens with a 2-min preload to drive VO₂ up, then 30 s easy, so the 30/15s start near VO₂peak instead of climbing into it (Vaccari et al., 2020). Self-paced: the highest power you can repeat across every series; the band is the floor. The preload is work, not warm-up. Bands assume a rider whose ramp MAP overstates 5-min power; a diesel rides the reps nearer 100% MAP. (Rønnestad et al., 2015, 2020; Odden et al., 2024.)

- Warm-up 15m 210w-250w

- Preload 2m 375w-395w 95rpm

- Short rec 30s 210w

8x
- On 30s 365w-395w
- Off 15s 210w

- Series rec 3m 210w

- Preload 2m 375w-395w 95rpm

- Short rec 30s 210w

8x
- On 30s 365w-395w
- Off 15s 210w

- Series rec 3m 210w

- Preload 2m 375w-395w 95rpm

- Short rec 30s 210w

8x
- On 30s 365w-395w
- Off 15s 210w

- Series rec 3m 210w

- Cooldown 10m 185w

<!-- template: vo2-preloaded-shorts -->

seedId: z2-endurance-2h
name:   Z2 endurance 2h
folder: Coach: Endurance
basis:  MAP @ 415w
type:   Ride
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Aerobic durability. Cap NP ≤65% MAP — above that it stops counting as Z2.

Aerobic durability work. Cap NP ≤ 65% MAP. Short excursions above range are fine if NP stays capped. If terrain or fatigue drives NP above the cap, this no longer counts as Z2.

- Endurance 2h 210w-270w
